test_name: login: top-level document title matches translated LOGIN.PAGE_TITLE
angular_behavior: After navigation, the top-level browser tab title is the translated login page title ("Login - Taiga").
react_behavior: The top-level document keeps the Vite shell title "Taiga (React port)"; the routed Angular title is not applied at the shell level.

test_name: login: top-level meta description matches translated LOGIN.PAGE_DESCRIPTION
angular_behavior: A single head meta[name="description"] exists and matches the translated LOGIN.PAGE_DESCRIPTION copy.
react_behavior: The React shell head does not expose the Angular route description meta at the top level (assertion on meta content fails).

test_name: login: top-level og:title meta matches page title
angular_behavior: head meta[property="og:title"] exists and equals the same string as the document title for the login route.
react_behavior: Top-level og:title is not updated to match the embedded Angular login title (shell-level head differs).

test_name: login: no full-viewport legacy iframe wrapper at top level
angular_behavior: The login UI is rendered directly in the host document (no taiga "legacy-frame" iframe).
react_behavior: A full-viewport iframe.legacy-frame wraps the Angular bundle, so the host document is not the Angular app root.

test_name: login: tg-legacy host element present in top-level document
subcategory: Angular bootstrap host missing in shell document
angular_behavior: The AngularJS bootstrap host element "tg-legacy" exists under body in the top-level document.
react_behavior: The shell document is React-only; tg-legacy exists only inside the iframe subtree, not at the top level.

test_name: forgot-password: top-level document title matches translated FORGOT_PASSWORD.PAGE_TITLE
angular_behavior: Top-level title becomes "Forgot password - Taiga" from translated route metadata.
react_behavior: Top-level title remains the React shell default instead of the translated forgot-password title.

test_name: discover: top-level document title matches translated DISCOVER.PAGE_TITLE
angular_behavior: Top-level title becomes "Discover projects - Taiga" from DiscoverHome controller meta.
react_behavior: Top-level title remains the React shell default; translated discover title is not applied at the shell document.
